name: Horror
description: Abandoned and unsettling environments. Entries describe physical layouts and decay without requiring danger, injuries or extra occupants.

entries: boarded-up seaside arcade with salt-corroded machines
empty municipal swimming pool with cracked tiles
abandoned weather station with a partly detached antenna
silent hotel corridor with peeling wallpaper and crooked doors
disused water-treatment hall with drained circular tanks
vacant apartment with rooms connected by missing doors
old ferry interior with rusted seat frames and a listing floor
sealed museum storage room with covered display cases
deserted roadside diner with dust-covered booths
abandoned asylum
abandoned theater with torn seating facing an empty stage
deserted motel courtyard with doors opening onto a covered walkway
empty hospital service corridor with recessed storage bays
disused observatory with a cracked dome above a circular platform
overgrown rail cutting leading toward a dark tunnel
foggy graveyard
derelict greenhouse with broken panes and overgrown planting beds
basement with exposed pipes, low beams and a narrow stairway
flooded cellar with a raised walkway along one wall
collapsed mine passage with a stable chamber beside the blocked route
